description: This file defines a web search provider plugin for the 'Exa' search engine, including functions for configuration, content parsing, search execution, and plugin creation.

methods.name: normalizeExaFreshness
methods.description: Normalizes a freshness string to a predefined set of values ('day', 'week', 'month', 'year').

methods.name: optionalStringEnum
methods.description: Creates an optional string enum type for schema validation.

methods.name: resolveExaConfig
methods.description: Resolves the Exa configuration from the search config record.

methods.name: resolveExaApiKey
methods.description: Retrieves the Exa API key from configuration or environment variables.

methods.name: resolveExaDescription
methods.description: Generates a description string from an Exa search result, prioritizing highlights, then summary, then text.

methods.name: parsePositiveInteger
methods.description: Parses a value as a positive integer if valid.

methods.name: invalidContentsPayload
methods.description: Creates an error payload indicating invalid contents.

methods.name: isErrorPayload
methods.description: Type guard to check if a value is an error payload.

methods.name: resolveExaSearchCount
methods.description: Determines the search count, constrained by maximum, with fallback.

methods.name: parseExaContents
methods.description: Parses and validates the contents argument for the search, supporting text, highlights, and summary options.

methods.name: normalizeExaResults
methods.description: Normalizes raw API response payload into an array of search results.

methods.name: resolveFreshnessStartDate
methods.description: Calculates the start date based on freshness value ('day', 'week', 'month', 'year').

methods.name: runExaSearch
methods.description: Executes a search request to the Exa API with specified parameters.

methods.name: createExaSchema
methods.description: Creates the JSON schema for search parameters.

methods.name: missingExaKeyPayload
methods.description: Returns payload indicating missing API key error.

methods.name: createExaToolDefinition
methods.description: Creates the web search tool definition for Exa, including execution logic.
